test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LJ - MK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/428d1b7f3b531978330d64e43b94417df0497c3a350b5e2efaac1368b926a426.png] 

Option 2) KN - IL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52c52ebb6baa3cb6d5a74fa2518946332d4706b2befd1138b90a198b08c3ce07.png] 

Option 3) IL - GJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59f37f842e2cceeede1f734dcf8196308990a0c9c3d2e3544e98ce744005e597.png] 

Option 4) QT - OR

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c59d0f6d5f52e3e11d77b6b0e9a1832ade5125015402da7340d4f7245fd52715.png] ​

Thus, out of all the options, 'LJ - MK' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
